# VTracer (copied unchanged)

From https://github.com/visioncortex/vtracer.git, commit 85caecf12ec9c971f43b22980bb80a7e082a4a12 (1.0.0-alpha.4).
Licence: MIT (see repo/LICENSE), Copyright (c) 2024 TSANG, Hao Fung. Only the Rust crates (engine, CLI, Python bindings)
are copied - the docs pictures, web app and Node bindings are left out. ShipBrain runs it through its Python package
(pip install "vtracer==1.0.0a4"), which is built from crates/vtracer-py.
